# The fixture site's robots.txt. Small on purpose, but not empty: an empty one
# would leave the robots handling untested by the live path.
User-agent: *
Disallow: /private/
# The paths CI-019 exists to keep out of an index. A search-results page, a cart
# and a login form are infinite, duplicated or private by nature.
Disallow: /search
Disallow: /cart
Disallow: /checkout
Disallow: /login

# GEO-003: an AI crawler policy names its crawlers. These four are named and told
# exactly what every crawler is told, so naming them changes no crawler's access.
User-agent: GPTBot
User-agent: ClaudeBot
User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
User-agent: Claude-SearchBot
Disallow: /private/
Disallow: /search
Disallow: /cart
Disallow: /checkout
Disallow: /login

Sitemap: http://127.0.0.1:8000/sitemap.xml
